title: Crowd Booing
blurb: Democracy's oldest review system, delivered at stadium scale and with real conviction. Booing is remarkable for being entirely collective: one person booing is an embarrassment, ten thousand is a verdict, and this crowd has plainly made up its mind. Play it after bad puns, worse decisions, and anybody suggesting the meeting run over. It functions as the exact counterweight to a cheering crowd. Same arena, same people, opposite ruling. The public has considered the matter and come back negatively.
origin: Stadium crowd booing: mass disapproval, instantly.
